The '''Circle Eternal''' was a plaza located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tahv]] on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. Later, the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] built a series of buildings including their [[Kesh capitol building|capitol building]] on the site of the Circle Eternal.

==History==
In ancient times, the native [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] from the village of [[Tahv]] regarded the Circle Eternal as a sacred place since it was built over a series of catacombs. Following the [[Great Calamity]] which occurred after the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] ancestors of [[the Doomed]] hid their last remaining [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Last Hope (Jedi starship)|''Last Hope'']] within the Keshiri catacombs beneath the Circle Eternal. By [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], it served as the gathering place for the [[Neshtovar]] council and was used for public meetings and trials. The Keshiri geologist [[Adari Vaal]] was tried for heresy there.

After the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith Tribe]] took over [[Keshtah Minor]], they built a cluster of buildings on the site of the Circle Eternal in [[4975 BBY]]. The Tribe's founder and first [[Grand Lord]] had ordered the construction of this complex to commemorate the twenty-fifth arrival of the Tribe, who had become regarded by the native [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] as the legendary [[Skyborn|Protectors]], mythical deities in Keshiri religion. At the center of this complex was the [[Kesh capitol building|capitol building]] which became the official residence of the Grand Lord.

The Circle became used for hosting celebrations like [[Testament Day]], the [[Festival of Nida's Rise]] and the Founding of the Tribe. It later fell into ruins and disrepair during [[Time of the Rot|the Time of the Rot]], a 960-year period of civil war and instability within the Sith Tribe. During the [[Hilts Restoration]], the new Grand Lord [[Varner Hilts]] oversaw the rebuilding of the Circle Eternal. During the [[Siege of Tahv]] in [[2974 BBY]], the plaza was damaged when the Sith anarchist [[Parlan Spinner]]'s Jedi Starship departed from its underground base. Later, the plaza sustained further damage when the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Remulus Dreypa]]'s [[Leviathan (creature)|Leviathans]] attacked the city.
